why: Commits 1 and 2 are exact CI and config edits held by a scan test. Commit 3 adds a new condition to the production deploy gate (deploy-needed.mjs and two appended if: clauses). Its unit test covers only the pure function, not the YAML wiring or the git fetch and diff inside the pending job, so a wrong condition could hold back a code deploy, or skip the wait, without any check failing before the push.
harm_if_wrong: A code push is silently not deployed (or deployed without the wait check), so production drifts from main until someone notices that /api/health reports an old commit.
make_it_cheaper: Move commit 3 (deploying only when more than tests changed) into its own step that a reviewer reads; commits 1 and 2 are then a cheap step.
brief_problems: The YAML snippet pins actions/cache@v4 while every other action in ci.yml is @v7; the prose says to match the file's age, so the literal snippet contradicts it
The TEST_ONLY pattern /^src\/test\// is safe only if no deployed code imports src/test; the brief does not ask for that check
